breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: While the generated specification mentions 'Use the standard k-Epsilon RAS turbulence model variant,' it also states 'Configure turbulence properties in `constant/turbulenceProperties` as specified in the original request.' The original request contains both RAS and LES blocks, so by referencing the original request's configuration, the specification effectively preserves the erroneous dual RAS+LES setup. The ground truth removes the LES block entirely, but the generated specification fails to explicitly do so.
